stages.label: Viable Events
stages.action: Re-segment source inputs into one canonical event before any dossier work.
stages.stopAction: Re-segment source inputs into one canonical event before any dossier work.

stages.label: Dossier Ready
stages.action: Enrich or split the Story Dossier; do not send thin or mixed evidence to the Writer.
stages.stopAction: Enrich or split the Story Dossier; do not send thin or mixed evidence to the Writer.

stages.label: Understanding Ready
stages.action: Build Story Understanding from the locked dossier before Writer Reasoning starts.
stages.stopAction: Build Story Understanding from the locked dossier before Writer Reasoning starts.

stages.label: Writer Ready
stages.action: Rerun Writer Reasoning from the locked dossier and required fact plan.
stages.stopAction: Rerun Writer Reasoning from the locked dossier and required fact plan.

stages.label: Draft Complete
stages.action: Generate only the article tier supported by the dossier; expand evidence instead of padding prose.
stages.stopAction: Generate only the article tier supported by the dossier; expand evidence instead of padding prose.

stages.label: Headline Valid
stages.action: Run headline-only repair through the Canonical Headline Service after body verification.
stages.stopAction: Run headline-only repair through the Canonical Headline Service after body verification.

stages.label: Editor Submitted
stages.action: Convert Editor findings into upstream prevention rules, then resubmit only after the responsible stage is repaired.
stages.stopAction: Convert Editor findings into upstream prevention rules, then resubmit only after the responsible stage is repaired.

stages.label: First-Pass Approved
stages.action: Use successful patterns to train Writer Reasoning and Headline Intelligence.
stages.stopAction: Use successful patterns to train Writer Reasoning and Headline Intelligence.
